title: Extinction thresholds in a graph-based model of HIV infection dynamics
summary: We study a graph-based cellular automaton for HIV infection dynamics in lymph-node networks, originally introduced by Mukwembi. Each vertex represents a cell site that may be healthy, infected, or dead, and the evolution is controlled by a replacement parameter $R$, which determines whether a dead cell is replaced by an infected or a healthy cell according to the number of its infected neighbors.
